title: Deterministic skeleton-aware weights for the implicit welded surface (MVP-critical)
description:
## Summary
Build a deterministic, skeleton-aware, build-time weighting model that authors per-vertex `VertexInfluence[]` for the implicit welded surface (Body + all SDF limb metaballs welded into one `GeometryType.Implicit` mesh). This is the deferred hard case TSK-0077 scoped out and is the MVP-critical enabler: real generated creature limbs are welded into this surface, so idle/walk is undemonstrable without it.

## Scope
- Consume the resolved rest-space implicit mesh vertices + `ResolvedCreatureSnapshot`/`SkeletonSnapshot`.
- Model: nearest point on eligible bone segment(s)/capsule axis, smoothly blended near joints; select up to 4 local influences and normalize deterministically. Restrict eligible influences to the vertex's source-part resolved semantic chain + nearby chain segments. Do NOT use nearest-bone-center Euclidean distance alone (bent chains).
- Resolve welded-surface mirrored contributions to mirrored semantic bones via `SemanticBoneResolver`/`MirrorUtility` reflection; no mirror-identity rediscovery; do not alter `RigBindingMetadata`.
- Weights are pose-independent build-time pure data on generation output; cached/precomputed; never recomputed per frame.
- Preserve the shared `SkeletonSnapshot.Capture` bone-index ordering invariant with the adapter (0132) and rigid weighting (0130).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Fixture matrix passes: straight limb, single bend, branch point, vertex near a joint seam, mirrored limb, and the generated Body/welded surface.
- Rest-pose equivalence and known-pose deformation match the `LinearBlendSkinning.Deform` oracle; <=4 influences/vertex; normalized; deterministic repeated generation.
- Mirror-consistent; invariant under stable canonical ordering and Unity scene order.
- No weight calculation during pose application; welded-surface mirror identity exercised (closes the deferred TSK-0054/TSK-0077 mirror gap on real geometry).

## Validation
Pure Tests.Runtime (headless; pure math): synthetic resolved-part fixtures for the matrix above + parity against LinearBlendSkinning. Real `GeneratedCreature` implicit surface PlayMode parity when Unity is available. dotnet Runtime + Tests.Runtime build and git diff --check.

## Findings
Confirmed (source/HEAD e88ba5d): generated implicit surface is ONE welded marching-cubes mesh (`SourcePartId=""`) containing body + limb surfaces; no per-vertex part attribution; no weighting code exists anywhere. LinearBlendSkinning doc explicitly leaves the welded Body surface out of scope until this model is validated.

## Blockers
Needs a resolved skeleton + rest vertices; pure math so headless-testable. The welded mesh has no per-primitive memory, so weights are geometric (segment nearest-point), the accepted documented approach.

## Next Step
Co-schedule with the SkinnedMeshRenderer adapter (0132); do NOT gate behind rigid mesh-asset weighting (0130). This is the primary MVP weighting task.
